title: Proposal is an optional visual supplement and historical Reviews use disclosure
context: With accepted specifications in Team Docs and G2 on GitHub PRs, most deliveries no longer need a Blueprint Change page. Deleting historical Reviews would lose accepted evidence and links.
decision: Create a Proposal only for a needed UI mockup or complex app/user/other process change that benefits from an interactive flowchart. Render Proposal directly with no tabs on all Change routes. Preserve historical Review and shard files as read-only collapsed footer disclosures, retaining their original and inner anchors and opening enclosing disclosures for deep links. New Changes create no Reviews. Keep the existing store until a separately accepted retirement.

alternatives.option: Keep tabs for historical pages only
alternatives.reason: Retains an obsolete navigation model and splits the renderer contract.

alternatives.option: Delete historical Reviews or rewrite them into PR summaries
alternatives.reason: Destroys accepted context or requires speculative reconstruction of evidence.

consequences: The complete accepted spec remains independent of visual presentation.
Shared renderer changes are validated against published historical pages without rewriting them.
